prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Expert Python / Machine Learning / NN Developer to help with (profitable) trading strategy
Expert Python(and PineScript) / Machine Learning / NN wiz to help develop a (profitable) trading strategy to use with a trading bot. Requirements: 1. A proven experience and in depth knowledge of writing trading strategies using Python / QuantConnect; i.e. writing complex strategies in Python and Backtest in QuantConnect 2. (MUST HAVE!!!) A proven experience and in-depth knowledge of Neural Networks, Machine Learning. 3. (bonus) Experience with AI 4. in-depth knowledge of trading, financial markets and trading strategies; you must be able to come up with technical solutions based on the requirements set by the team.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Parent survey analysis
client: Riverbend Education Fund
client_industry: nonprofit
start: 2021-08
end: 2021-09
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Python
- pandas
- Excel
- statistics
implied_skills:
- survey weighting
built: Cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response parent survey and wrote the findings
  for the board.
metrics:
- 4,200 responses analysed
- 3 findings adopted in the next funding plan

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Parent survey analysis (p03).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m passionate about solving complex data problems and I’m a hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’d love to help you develop a trading strategy that is technically sound, data-driven, and built to support a trading bot.

Your project is the kind of challenge I’m interested in: combining Python-based strategy development, QuantConnect backtesting, and machine learning/Neural Networks to create a practical solution. I understand you need someone who can think through technical requirements carefully and translate them into structured, testable logic. While my core background is in data analysis and reporting, I bring a strong analytical mindset, comfort with messy data, and experience building clear, decision-ready outputs from complex datasets.

One project I can point to is Parent survey analysis for Riverbend Education Fund, where I used Python, pandas, Excel, and statistics to clean and weight a 4,200-response parent survey and write the findings for the board. The work led to 3 findings being adopted in the next funding plan. That project strengthened my ability to handle large datasets, apply disciplined analysis, and communicate results in a way that supports real decisions.

For your trading strategy work, I can help by organizing data, building analysis workflows, supporting signal evaluation, and contributing to testing and refinement of strategy logic. I’m comfortable working in structured, iterative ways and I value clarity, reproducibility, and careful validation. I also understand that in trading, the quality of the approach matters as much as the code, so I’d be focused on helping you turn requirements into a robust analytical framework.

I’d welcome the chance to discuss your goals, the data you have available, and how you want the strategy to behave. If you’re looking for someone reliable, analytical, and collaborative, I’d be glad to contribute.
